notes.title: Feedback update
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has been playing the game and providing feedback!

Based on this I've made the following changes:

[list]
[*]You can now sell items in the Forge instead of buying them.
[*]Fixed a rare issue where enemies could spawn in lava.
[*]Added tooltips to the power up cards.
[*]You now automatically hoover up everything on round end, apart from Health which you may want to save for later use.
[*]The gold farm Indicates how much gold it will make (currently 30 per round).
[*]You now insta-build between rounds.
[*]Big enemies drop bigger gold rewards by default.
[*]Made the hotspots at basecamp slightly more obvious.
[/list]

notes.title: Achievements, Controller Support, bug fixes, balancing
notes.content:
Our first patch is live!

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Achievements added
[*]Partial* Controller Support added
[/list]

[b]Fixes/Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]Gold Farms now generate gold at the end of a wave rather than every 5 seconds.
[*]Heal Surge now upgrades properly.
[*]Difficulty balancing for Hard mode.
[/list]

*We couldn't get full controller support working at this time, but you can at least move the character with a controller.
